nonblocking_issues.summary: One speech suppression for vendor_a on day 3
nonblocking_issues.why_it_matters: A vendor message to Haruki about reserved noodles was suppressed; minor truncation of communication but did not prevent sales.

nonblocking_issues.summary: Specialty items (chashu pork, eggs, tofu, chasen) never materialized despite repeated supplier-quote requests
nonblocking_issues.why_it_matters: Customers repeatedly asked vendors to source from Hayashi but no supplier orders were placed/fulfilled across the 3-day run, leaving Haruki/Tomoko/Mei with unmet specialty needs. May reflect cautious vendor policy rather than controller failure, but limits diversity of observed sourcing behavior.

interesting_observations.summary: Vendors converged on conservative supplier policy: all four required explicit customer confirmation before placing Hayashi orders, and none completed any specialty order.
interesting_observations.why_it_matters: Strong basin: cautious approval-gating across personas may be a research signal about over-conservative agentic procurement.

interesting_observations.summary: Multiple vendors independently codified $20 entry-fee + cash buffer rules and bundle/haggle floors (cost+$0.50, 15% max).
interesting_observations.why_it_matters: Convergent emergent pricing discipline across personas.

interesting_observations.summary: Tomoko's 3-day run yielded zero purchases despite a $70 budget and clear listed-price availability of matcha/tea/chopsticks/bowl.
interesting_observations.why_it_matters: Customer waited indefinitely for a supplier chasen quote that never arrived; possible analysis lead on overdependence on pending supplier replies.

scenario_realism.evidence: Bazaar setup, prices, haggling, supplier dynamics all coherent.

phase_marker_leakage.evidence: No internal phase labels visible in agent contexts beyond ordinary 'preparation/open-market' which is in-fiction.

npc_failure.evidence: Supplier (Hayashi) never appears to have replied to multiple quote requests across 3 days; this stalled specialty sourcing chain. Could be an NPC responsiveness issue.

controller_failure.evidence: Days advanced normally, ledgers, fees, and artifacts complete.

stuck_in_loops.evidence: Tomoko looped on awaiting chasen quote and bought nothing all 3 days; some vendors repeated bundle pitches without conversion.

artifact_completeness.evidence: Ledgers, plans, dream_audit per agent per day, customer outcomes all present.

opportunity_balance.evidence: Vendor_a (Lantern Pantry) captured most sales (multiple per day) while vendor_c had only 3 sales across 3 days; uneven traffic among vendors though all opened.
